title: Castelion media slot
description: A media slot that fills its box: a real image or video covers it like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a plain token surface: flat muted, a dusk wash (muted into the warm glow) for film, or a sky wash (navy into the highlight blue) for photo cards.
notes: size and round it from outside (aspect-*, size-full, rounded-lg)
name: castelion-placeholder

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; it is stretched to cover the slot. Empty: a plain token surface

props.name: tone
props.description: muted: flat surface · dusk: muted into the warm glow (film) · sky: navy into the highlight blue (photo cards)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will show, for screen readers (only used while it is empty)
